hook: European Commission Declares Browser Competition a Digital Markets Act Priority
hookText: European Commission Declares Browser Competition a Digital Markets Act Priority

beats.say: The European Commission has made browser competition a priority under the Digital Markets Act, a win for the open-web advocates who campaigned for it.
